characters.name: Dronningen
characters.description: A regal and dignified woman, the queen rides in a grand sleigh during a snowy winter. She has a commanding presence, with an elegant winter cloak lined with fur to shield her from the cold. Her facial features are gentle yet sharp, with a crown signifying her royal status. Her complexion is fair, accentuated with strands of chestnut hair peeking from under her headdress.

characters.name: Snehvid og Rosenrød
characters.description: The princess has an ethereal beauty with skin as white as snow and lips as red as blood, reflecting her name. She is of average height and slender build, dressed in simple yet elegant clothes appropriate for a journey. Her dark hair flows freely, with a determined expression showing her resolve. She is often seen in natural settings like forests, emphasizing her connection to her quest.

characters.name: De tolv prinser
characters.description: Once transformed into princes, they reveal a distinguished and noble bearing. Each prince is tall, with fair hair and striking regal attire that matches their royal origin. They have earnest expressions, often depicted in action as they transform back from wild ducks. The youngest prince notably has an andevinge instead of a left arm, a remnant of their curse.

characters.name: Troldkjærring
characters.description: An ominous and mysterious figure, the witch appears with an air of foreboding. Her appearance is aged, with a weathered face and a hunched posture. Clad in dark, ragged robes, she exudes an aura of malevolence and magical power.

characters.name: Unge Kongen
characters.description: A handsome and kind young monarch, the king is dressed in fine royal attire, with a crown atop his head symbolizing his status. He has a warm smile and gentle eyes, indicative of his benevolent nature. His noble demeanor is evident in his interactions, particularly when encountering Snehvid og Rosenrød.

characters.name: Slemme Dronningen
characters.description: The old queen, who is the king's stepmother, has a sinister and jealous appearance. She is often seen with a scowl, dressed in richly extravagant garments that contrast with her malicious intent. Her piercing eyes and sharp features are indicative of her deceitful and envious character.
